The Megalopolis of Science!'') is the 28th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{spoilers}}{{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Zossie]] introduces {{adv|Sun}} and {{adv|Moon}} to the [[Ultra Megalopolis]]. * A {{p|Stakataka}} arrives to battle {{p|Necrozma}}. * Sun and Moon meet [[Soliera]], another [[Ultra Recon Squad]] member. * Soliera forces Sun and Moon to battle Stakataka to prove their strength. * [[Lusamine]] receives a large amount of [[Beast Ball]]s from {{adv|Blake}} disguised as [[Colress]], which she aims to use to capture Necrozma. {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Stakataka}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Blake}} (disguised as [[Colress]]; silhouette) * {{adv|Sun}} * {{adv|Moon}} * [[Lusamine]] * [[Zossie]] * [[Soliera]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Torracat}} ({{adv|Dollar}}; {{adv|Sun}}'s) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Rotom Pokédex]]; {{OP|Moon|Rotom}}) * {{p|Dartrix}} ({{OP|Moon|Dartrix}}) * {{p|Zygarde}} ({{adv|Zygarde|Adventures}}; {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Zygarde Cells}}) * {{p|Lunala}} ({{DL|Nebby|In the manga|Adventures}}) * {{p|Necrozma}} ({{adv|Necrozma|Adventures}}; {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Necrozma|Dusk Mane Necrozma}}; fantasy) * {{p|Stakataka}} (later {{adv|Sun}}'s) * {{p|Poipole}} * {{p|Nihilego}} (multiple) ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|SM}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|SM}} |zh_cmn={{tt|到达！科学的巨大都市！ |Arrival!!
